description: Header file defining the AV1Decoder class and its nested AV1Accelerator interface for hardware-accelerated AV1 video decoding within Chromium's media GPU component.

classes.name: AV1Decoder
classes.description: Main class for decoding AV1 video streams with hardware acceleration, managing decoding state, reference frames, and interaction with an AV1Accelerator.

classes.name: AV1Decoder::AV1Accelerator
classes.description: Interface for hardware-accelerated decoding operations, including creating pictures, submitting decode requests, and outputting pictures.

methods.name: AV1Decoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with an accelerator, profile, and color space.

methods.name: SetStream
methods.description: Sets the input stream for decoding.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder to initial state.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Performs decoding of the current stream.

methods.name: GetPicSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the current picture.

methods.name: GetVisibleRect
methods.description: Returns the visible rectangle of the current picture.

methods.name: GetProfile
methods.description: Returns the profile of the current stream.

methods.name: GetBitDepth
methods.description: Returns the bit depth of the current stream.

methods.name: GetRequiredNumOfPictures
methods.description: Returns the number of pictures required for decoding.

methods.name: GetNumReferenceFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of reference frames.
